stages.reference: Create a close material reference for the top face of a thick cactus in a grounded dark-fantasy desert. The surface should reveal radial succulent growth: dense waxy green tissue arranged around a subtly recessed growing center, with pale fibrous ribs, small spine bases and signs of sun stress. Moisture is stored inside but the exterior remains matte-waxy rather than wet. Use subdued sage and olive green with dusty yellow-green highlights. Avoid a flower, sliced fruit, perfect mandala symmetry, glossy cucumber flesh or dramatic spikes. Make the top clearly belong to the same drought-hardened cactus while expressing its radial growth direction.
